meta.name: youtube-watcher
meta.description: Fetch and read transcripts from YouTube videos. Use when you need to summarize a video, answer questions about its content, or extract information from it.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提取并阅读 YouTube 视频字幕
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从 YouTube 视频中获取文字信息
copy.tagline_en: Fetch and read YouTube video transcripts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract text information from YouTube videos

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以获取 YouTube 视频的文字转录，并基于转录内容进行总结、回答提问或提取信息。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 观看 YouTube 视频、总结视频内容、获取视频转录或分析视频时触发。
howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can fetch the text transcript of a YouTube video and then summarize it, answer questions, or extract information based on the transcript.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to watch a YouTube video, summarize a video, get a video transcript, or analyze a video.

say_en.note: Claude fetches the transcript and provides a summary.

say_en.text: What are the key points in this video? https://youtube.com/watch?v=xyz789
say_en.note: Claude searches the transcript and answers.
